_README: devseed-only. This wires the SAME eight hooks that plugins/governed-dev/hooks/hooks.json ships to consumers, but against ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} -- this repository's working tree -- instead of the installed plugin. It is not copied anywhere and is not part of the plugin.
_WHY_THIS_EXISTS: devseed is governed by the tool it produces (ADR-0001), but it cannot dogfood the hooks through the plugin. plugin.json deliberately omits "version", so an install resolves to a commit SHA and is pinned at install time -- the copy on this machine sits 11 commits behind HEAD with an empty gates/ directory. Without this file, a change to a hook would not take effect in devseed until it was committed, pushed, and explicitly updated, which is exactly the copy-and-drift loop devseed exists to remove.
_MIRROR_WARNING: This is a MIRROR, and mirrors drift. The SCRIPTS are shared -- there is one copy of each, under plugins/governed-dev/hooks/ -- so drift is confined to the event set, the matchers, and the async flags below. hooks.json is the source of truth; this file follows it. T-006's drift guards assert the two agree, because nothing else will notice.
_SHELL_FORM: Shell form with "shell": "bash" and quoted placeholders, matching hooks.json. Exec form would require bash on PATH, which it is not on this machine -- the hooks would silently never run. See ADR-0010.
